rows.note: App_Menu_ContactUs Q3 (a): TST tests /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_&\-.+]{0,31}@[a-z0-9-]{1,}(\.[a-z0-9]{2,20}){1,}$/i on text.toLowerCase() with no trim (UBTConnectLibrary.controller.js:7565-7569); the caller passes ContactUsForm.Email as is (ContactUsDetails.mvc.js:1918). React uses the same expression on in_Text.trim().toLowerCase(): an e-mail with a leading or trailing space is valid in React and "Invalid email!" on TST.
